title: Seasons
author: Poster
description:
Breakneck development effort on Sircon’s latest product — Inspire 3.2 — had kept you working 60-hour weeks for months.

Inspire went gold master yesterday. Yesterday night was the riotous celebration, complete with developers dancing on tables and the infamous ‘Did You Touch This Ticket’ drinking game. Yesterday at midnight was the dream. Again.

(This was an entry to IntroComp, and is thus incomplete.)
